sidebar.aboutBody: Clone a voice from a short sample, then generate speech in any voice across any language. Ship TTS into AI agents, games, podcasts, or long-form narration.

clone.title: Clone any voice in seconds.
clone.body: A few seconds of reference audio is enough. Multi-sample support for higher quality when you want it.

engines.title: Seven engines, 23 languages.
engines.body: Pick the tradeoff that fits — quality, speed, or multilingual coverage.

agentReady.title: Agent-ready.
agentReady.body: REST API with per-profile control — give any AI a voice you've cloned.

dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.description: Capture from anywhere on your machine with a global shortcut.

globalShortcut.title: Global shortcut
globalShortcut.description: Hold the shortcut to record from anywhere on your machine. Release to transcribe.

pushToTalk.title: Push-to-talk shortcut
pushToTalk.description: Hold these keys anywhere on your system to record. Release to stop and transcribe.

toggle.title: Toggle shortcut
toggle.description: Press once to start a hands-free recording. Press again to stop. Usually push-to-talk plus Space.

chordPicker.pttDescription: Hold the keys you want to use, then release and click Save. The right-hand modifier badge shows whether a key is the left or right variant.
chordPicker.toggleDescription: Hold the keys you want to use, then release and click Save. Pick something distinct from your push-to-talk chord.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: What appears on screen while you're holding the shortcut.

copyToClipboard.title: Copy transcript to clipboard
copyToClipboard.description: The cleaned transcript lands on your clipboard when the capture finishes.

autoPaste.title: Auto-paste into focused text field
autoPaste.description: If a text input is focused in another app, paste directly into it. Voice Studio Box saves and restores whatever was on your clipboard.

transcription.title: Transcription
transcription.description: Pick which speech-to-text model runs on your captures.

model.title: Transcription model
model.description: Whisper ships with Voice Studio Box and runs entirely on your machine.

language.title: Language
language.description: Auto-detect works for most captures. Lock it if you're always speaking the same language.

archive.title: Archive audio
archive.description: Keep the original recording alongside every transcript.

refinement.title: Refinement
refinement.description: Optionally run a local LLM over transcripts to clean filler words, punctuation, and self-corrections.

auto.title: Refine transcripts automatically
auto.description: Runs after every capture. You can still toggle between raw and refined in the Captures tab.

model.title: Refinement model
model.description: Larger models are slower but handle subtle self-corrections and technical vocabulary better.

smartCleanup.title: Smart cleanup
smartCleanup.description: Remove filler words (um, uh, like), restore punctuation, and fix capitalization without rephrasing.

selfCorrection.title: Remove self-corrections
selfCorrection.description: When you change your mind mid-sentence ("actually, no...", "wait, I meant..."), drop the retracted part and keep the final intent.

preserveTechnical.title: Preserve technical terms
preserveTechnical.description: Keep code identifiers, command names, and acronyms exactly as spoken. Turn on when you dictate into a code prompt.

customEndpoint.title: Custom LLM endpoint (advanced)
customEndpoint.description: Delegate refinement and personality rewrites to any OpenAI-compatible server — llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio, LocalAI, Ollama's shim, or the OpenAI API itself. Leave blank to use the built-in Qwen3.
customEndpoint.apiKeyPlaceholderReplace: Enter a new key to replace the stored one
customEndpoint.statusBuiltin: Using the built-in Qwen3 model selected above.
customEndpoint.statusRemote: Sending every refinement and personality rewrite to {{endpoint}}.

playback.title: Playback
playback.description: Default voice for the "Play as" action in the Captures tab.

defaultVoice.title: Default voice
defaultVoice.description: Used when you click Play as without picking a voice first. You can change it per capture.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Captures are saved as paired audio and transcript files in your Voice Studio Box data directory.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: How long to keep captures. Applies to both audio and transcripts.

folder.title: Captures folder
folder.description: Where capture audio and transcripts are stored on disk.

sidebar.aboutBody: Hold a shortcut anywhere on your machine, speak, and Voice Studio Box turns your voice into text. Replay it in any cloned voice, paste it into any app, or pipe it into your coding agent.

local.title: Fully local.
local.body: Whisper and the refinement LLM run on your hardware. No cloud, no accounts, your voice never leaves the machine.

remote.title: Refinement runs remotely.
remote.body: Whisper still transcribes on your hardware, but refined transcripts and personality rewrites are sent to {{endpoint}}. Voice audio itself never leaves the machine.

playAs.title: Play as any voice.
playAs.body: Transcripts can be read back in any profile you've cloned.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform.
crossPlatform.body: Same shortcut, same flow on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

windowsCaveat.title: Heads-up on Windows
windowsCaveat.body: The shortcut won't fire while Voice Studio Box itself or any app running as administrator is focused. Working on it.

install.title: Install into your agent
install.description: Voice Studio Box exposes a local MCP server whenever the app is open. Paste one of these snippets into your agent's MCP config.

http.title: HTTP (recommended)
http.description: For clients that speak HTTP MCP — Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code.

claudeCode.title: Claude Code one-liner
claudeCode.description: Registers via the Claude Code CLI.

stdio.title: Stdio (fallback)
stdio.description: For clients that only spawn stdio processes. The shim binary ships with the app.

defaultVoice.title: Default voice
defaultVoice.description: Used when an agent calls voicebox_speak without a specific profile and has no per-client binding.
defaultVoice.label: Default playback voice
defaultVoice.labelHint: Shared with the Captures-tab 'Play as voice' dropdown — one default voice for passive playback.

bindings.title: Per-agent voice
bindings.description: Bind specific agents to specific voices so you can tell who's speaking without looking. The agent identifies itself by the X-Voicebox-Client-Id header (or VOICEBOX_CLIENT_ID env for stdio).
bindings.empty: No bindings yet. Add one below, then configure your MCP client to send the matching X-Voicebox-Client-Id.

sidebar.aboutBody: Model Context Protocol lets your AI coding agent — Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf — call Voice Studio Box tools. Speak in a cloned voice, transcribe audio, browse captures.

tools.speak: Speak text in a voice profile.

sidebar.postSpeak: Also exposed as POST /speak for shell scripts, ACP, A2A.

gpu.footer: Voice Studio Box uses an NVIDIA GPU (CUDA) when available. Without a GPU it runs on the CPU: every model still works, just much slower.

rocm.title: AMD ROCm Backend
rocm.description: AMD GPU acceleration via a downloadable ROCm backend.

removeRocm.description: Delete the downloaded ROCm binary to free disk space.

about.tagline: The open-source voice synthesis studio. Clone voices, generate speech, apply effects, and build voice-powered apps — all running locally on your machine.

speed.sectionDescription: Applies to every engine after synthesis. Pitch is preserved.
speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Default speed for new generations, batches and API/MCP calls.

export.sectionDescription: Defaults used when downloading audio from History and Batch.

format.title: Default file format
format.description: WAV is lossless and largest, FLAC is lossless and smaller, MP3 is smallest.

bitrate.title: MP3 bitrate
bitrate.description: Higher is better quality and a bigger file. 192 kbps suits most voice work.

loudness.title: Loudness normalization
loudness.description: Brings every generation to the same perceived loudness (EBU R128, peak capped at -1 dBFS). Applies to new generations.

pronunciation.title: Pronunciation dictionary
pronunciation.description: Words, names and abbreviations are rewritten before they reach the voice engine, so they are read the way you want. History and subtitles keep your original text.

enable.title: Use the dictionary
enable.description: Turn off to read text exactly as written.

pronunciation.empty: No entries yet. Add a word, or import a CSV with two columns: written form, spoken form.
pronunciation.importHint: CSV format: one entry per line, "written,spoken" (comma, semicolon or tab). Longer entries win over shorter ones, and replacements are never re-replaced.
pronunciation.importEmpty: No entries found in that file

test.title: Try it
test.placeholder: Type a sentence to see what the engine will actually read…

vram.title: GPU memory (VRAM)
vram.description: Live usage of your graphics card and the models currently loaded.
vram.noCuda: No CUDA GPU detected — models run on the CPU, so VRAM management does not apply.

idle.title: Free voice models when idle
idle.description: Unload TTS models after this long without generating. The next generation reloads the model (a few seconds).

exclusive.title: One voice engine at a time
exclusive.description: Unload other TTS engines before loading a new one, so switching engines never overflows VRAM. Recommended for 8 GB cards.

refinePrompt.title: Custom prompt for the LLM
refinePrompt.description: Your own instructions for the model that cleans up transcripts.

steps.title: OmniVoice quality
steps.description: Decoding steps. More steps sound cleaner and take longer.

cooldown.title: Rest between scripts
cooldown.description: After a script or batch finishes, models are unloaded from RAM/VRAM and the queue waits this long before the next one.

qc.sectionDescription: Whisper listens to each generated passage and regenerates the ones with missing words or stray sounds.

mode.title: Check generated speech
mode.description: Generation takes longer because every passage is checked. Needs the Whisper Turbo model.

retries.title: Retries per passage
retries.description: The best attempt is kept if none passes.

batch.title: Batch generation
batch.description: Turn a .txt or .csv file into many audio files at once — download them separately or merged into one, with matching subtitles.

input.title: 1. Text
input.hint: CSV: a "text" column (or the first column) and an optional "filename" column. TXT: paragraphs separated by a blank line, or one line per item.
input.empty: No text found in that file

progress.none: No batches yet. Load a file on the left to start.

download.title: 3. Download
download.failedNote: Failed items are skipped. Use Retry in History, then download again.

emotion.label: Emotion
emotion.sampleHint: Cloning follows the delivery of its sample. Give a voice one take per emotion and the matching one is used.

support.direct: This engine acts on the emotion directly.
support.intensity: This engine changes how expressive the voice is; pitch and pace add the rest.
support.reference: This engine copies the emotion of its sample. For the strongest effect, add a sample recorded in that emotion and tag it in the voice's sample list.
support.prosody: This engine has no emotion control, so only pace, pitch and level change.

designTakes.title: Reference clip
designTakes.hint: Every take in this voice is cloned from the chosen clip, so a whole text and every line stay the same person. The first time the voice is used in a language, 4 takes are made, scored, and the most natural correctly-read one is used (the first time also downloads a 392 MB scoring model). You can listen and pick another.
designTakes.create: Make a reference clip for this language
designTakes.working: Making and scoring 4 takes, about a minute...

designTakes.wordsHint: Whisper listens back and compares with the line
